units: <cite ref="Niddah 59b:9">Nidd. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>במְזַנֶּקֶת</he> it means a woman discharging urin in a gush.
<cite ref="Chullin 38a:13">Ḥull. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>זִינְּקָה</he> the animal’s blood sputtered (when its jugular arteries were cut).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 1:5:4">Y. Yoma I, 39ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>חוטמו מְזַנֵּק תולעים</he> his nose discharging worms.

senses.gloss: [to make a persons’ mouth water,] to make a person sick by withholding from him a desired dish.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 16">Ex. R. s. 16</cite>, end <he>אתם זִינַּקְתֶּם את בני וכ׳</he> ye made my children sick by withholding from them meat, when ye ate &c.

senses.gloss: to drop, to pour. Y. Sabb. VIII, 11ᵇ bot. במַזְנִיק שנו the Mishnah means when one uses pitch or sulphur in a liquid state.
